summary: Patrick Industries filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 9, 2026, it and merger target LCI Industries each received a Second Request for additional information from the DOJ regarding their June 30, 2026 merger agreement. Under the deal, LCI would merge into a Patrick subsidiary in a two-step structure, surviving as a wholly owned Patrick subsidiary. HSR filings were made August 5, withdrawn September 4, then refiled September 9; the Second Request extends the waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance. A Form S-4 was filed September 23, 2026. Watch regulatory timing and potential divestiture remedies.
